name: optical-design
description: Understand lenses, calculate optical limits, improve supported designs, and share measured results.

interface.shortDescription: Understand a lens and share the evidence
interface.longDescription: Learn with a visual lens example, answer camera and microscopy questions, or inspect and improve a supported prescription. Portable Optiland computation needs Python and uv; native .zos work requires licensed OpticStudio on Windows.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through the bundled lens example and explain the before/after figures.
Help me check camera sampling for my microscope.
Inspect my lens, check import fidelity, and suggest a measured improvement.
